name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Anders, Technician, and Fungus belong to different colonists.
Engineer goes with at least one of Helix or Diatoms.
Pilot goes with exactly two of Dasari, Helix, and Fungus.
Anders, Pilot, and Lumen belong to different colonists.
Helix goes with none of Engineer, Technician, or Diatoms.
